terms.definition: Exposing an object to nuclear radiation; the object does not become radioactive.
Unwanted presence of radioactive atoms on or in materials.
terms.examiner: Contamination continues until the source is removed or decays.

terms.definition: Publishing findings so that other scientists can check them; important for data on the effects of radiation.
terms.examiner: Peer review makes findings more reliable.

terms.definition: Use tongs, keep a distance, minimise time of exposure, wear gloves, store sources in lead-lined boxes.
terms.examiner: Explain how each reduces the dose.
